features.title: Reproducible Mac handoff and safe workspace

steps.work: Import the pinned published commit into a fresh standalone clone, new non-main/dev branch. Verify all baseline source paths using the transferred inventory.
steps.acceptance: Commit, 826 source files, modes, no missing/extra source, and diagnostic workflow hash match. No ignored runtime files or credentials transferred.

steps.work: Inventory toolchain, macOS version/architecture, stock Bash/BSD tools; establish private work/evidence/cache directories and disposable native runner.
steps.acceptance: Reviewer can reproduce environment identity and demonstrate writes cannot reach the old/installed checkout.

steps.work: Establish a **new** all-source baseline; map the accumulated diff against original base `ef9f843…` into the feature reviews below (not one giant up-front review). Preserve historical limitations; quarantine the two-file pending patch.
steps.acceptance: Every accumulated path has a review owner/feature; full current review completes by F13. No historical all-path preservation claim. Independent disposition for old C2F2D scope gap is still required before final readiness.

features.title: Fast, safe Mac test loop and genuine platform coverage

steps.work: Inventory each existing suite's effects. Prove fail-on-use service/Herdr/Tailscale/deployment adapters are actually reached, including absolute sibling script calls.
steps.acceptance: An intentionally wrong sibling/service adapter fails before any real service call. Preserve TS-TEST-001 safety repair.

steps.work: Add narrow test-runner entrypoints for pure/file checks, stock-Mac shell fixtures, native process fixtures and Linux-only process fixtures. No product hooks.
steps.acceptance: Wrong OS/architecture/prerequisite exits non-success with a classified reason; a required case cannot disappear as a passing skip.

steps.work: Split `make shell-check` into a portable contract suite plus explicit native/Linux-specific jobs while preserving all old assertions. Replace or isolate `/proc`, `mapfile`, GNU `timeout`; test BSD utilities and stock `/bin/bash`.
steps.acceptance: Mac portable + Mac lifecycle and Linux portable + Linux lifecycle all accounted for. Do not merely skip `tests/test_tailscale.sh` on Darwin.

steps.work: Correct test-fixture mode and networking assumptions: explicitly chmod expected fixtures; use available private loopback, not public services.
steps.acceptance: Relevant suites pass under umask 022 and 077; deliberate mode/loopback errors fail clearly. Full suite is no longer "green" by separately choosing favorable umasks.

steps.work: Capture the baseline boolean-accessor failure using stock `/usr/bin/sed` on Mac and GNU POSIX mode as Linux negative control. Inspect emitted fixture JSON locally.
steps.acceptance: Explain whether the 70-byte incomplete-inspection refusal is reproduced; keep native logs separate from hypothesis.

steps.work: Specify a bounded typed/top-level response contract. Prefer Go standard-library parsing through an existing/narrow helper or a rigorously tested portable parser; do not build a larger regex parser. Evaluate bootstrap/helper recursion before choosing a Go subcommand.
steps.acceptance: Design covers duplicates including escaped keys, wrong types, malformed/trailing/deep/oversized JSON, missing fields, string lookalikes and nested shadows. No new user runtime dependency.

steps.work: Implement boolean consumption and a focused table test; audit string/number fields used for origin/run/instance to prevent the same problem. Change other accessors only in separate needed substeps.
steps.acceptance: Stock BSD/Mac tests and GNU/Linux tests agree. Exact valid true/false succeed; escaped lookalike, incomplete or malformed data never authorizes mutation/cleanup/pairing. Pre-fix and permissive mutants fail.

steps.work: Run the actual inert launcher through preflight with complete/partial/unknown fixtures.
steps.acceptance: Complete fixture advances to the next genuine gate; incomplete fixtures make zero child/config/Serve effects. This is not real session ownership.

features.title: Foreground process lifecycle works on native macOS and Linux

steps.work: Improve the Darwin test harness first: bounded nonce/role handshake length/time, early launcher-exit detection, sanitized startup diagnostics, exact role/EOF accounting.
steps.acceptance: Fixture that exits before handshake fails promptly with useful error category, not four blind 45-second waits. Wrong nonce/duplicate role/partial handshake fails.

steps.work: Run native Go supervisor normal/race + inspector inherited-pipe tests on Mac. Fix one concrete lifecycle defect per substep.
steps.acceptance: Direct-child exit, held output pipes, cancellation, ignored signals and group-anchor retirement complete within defined deadlines. Mutants removing WaitDelay/group ownership fail.

steps.work: Run each Darwin launcher scenario individually, then the whole matrix: normal termination, relay leader exit, Serve leader exit, cleanup-failure retention; foreign survival. Use stock Bash.
steps.acceptance: All expected owned role channels reach EOF; no unrelated signal; session/log deletion only with proof. Preserve deliberate post-KILL proof refusal and never cache an unproved identity.

steps.work: Run Linux child-job 19+, launcher-order 7+, group 4+ and native Go/race counterparts on the same source. Repeat race-sensitive scenarios a fixed count (e.g. 20), preserving every outcome.
steps.acceptance: No retry-until-green; injected missing/mismatched records and unsafe-cache mutants fail as designed. Distinguish direct target retirement from separately owned group cleanup.

features.title: Real Serve session authority (early design gate)

steps.work: Reconcile `internal/tailscale/CONTRACT.md` with upstream pinned source: CLI/daemon 1.102.4, commit `bbcd7d1fc2054b9189ebc1531acf74bd880ca0c8`. Write an ADR for independently bound session authority.
steps.acceptance: Reject circular `expected=observed`, PID-only, new-route-diff, origin/port matching or a healthy relay as session proof. State feasibility explicitly.

steps.decisionGate: Explicit owner approval for new authority/API/CLI distribution/version scope if required by chosen design
steps.work: If a supported parent-bound CLI mechanism exists, pin and specify it. Otherwise present a concrete choice: approved newer upstream contract, explicit relay-owned LocalAPI session scope, custom CLI distribution scope, or continued unavailable feature.
steps.acceptance: **Owner authorization required** for new LocalAPI mutation/CLI distribution/tracing/version scope. Do not implement an unapproved alternative or mark DR-1 closed by assumption.

steps.work: Implement the chosen adapter behind a narrow authority interface, with pure/fake contract tests; bind canonical HTTPS host/port, Proxy `/`, loopback backend, session and owned lifetime.
steps.acceptance: Foreign same-origin replacement, extra route, background/Funnel state, stale channel and arbitrary observed session all refuse. Test real caller, not only a permissive stub.

steps.work: Wire pre-consent, post-consent/immediately-pre-mutation and runtime/reprint identity checks; require HTTPS eligibility without interactive automatic enablement.
steps.acceptance: Changed node/account/tailnet/DNS/version, logout, partial status, or missing HTTPS prerequisites: no start/arm/QR and no foreign cleanup. Real compatibility deferred to F12.

features.title: One managed owner across every writer

steps.decisionGate: Explicit owner approval if narrowing unconditional same-UID preservation promise (DR-2)
steps.work: Audit writers and install-root/O/T ordering; decide/document DR-2 retirement threat model.
steps.acceptance: No age/PID stale takeover. Explicit distinction between cooperating-writer checks and impossible portable atomic compare-and-unlink against arbitrary same-UID replacement. Owner decision needed to narrow any stronger promise.

steps.work: Setup/start/menu/chooser group; bootstrap missing roots explicitly, use read-only resolution before admission.
steps.acceptance: Held O causes zero mkdir/chmod/env/key/origin writes, zero launches and preserved winner state; aliases converge.

steps.work: `configure-app-deploy` and read-only status/dev entrypoints.
steps.acceptance: Refusal precedes config/credential reads that have effects, job creation, downloads or service calls. Status never arms; dev roots cannot alias production.

steps.work: Service install/uninstall/restart wrappers (one family per handoff).
steps.acceptance: No service stop/start/unit/plist mutation on contention or selected foreground mode; inert managers only.

steps.work: Rotation, hostname, teardown/uninstall (one action per handoff).
steps.acceptance: No credential loss, foreign-file deletion, endpoint change, or route effect on refusal. Existing allowed legacy action remains functional.

steps.work: Plugin/build/install/activation/pruning and shared release roots.
steps.acceptance: One lock ordering for both shell install and Go update; two config roots sharing an install root cannot race activation/pruning.

steps.work: Go update/appdeploy schedule/worker/recovery constructors.
steps.acceptance: Reconcile existing flock regimes; validate at worker boundary, including constructor/recovery writes, not only shell admission. Network/job/deploy sentinels remain unused on refusal.

steps.work: Cross-writer race matrix, crash retention and canonical-path aliases.
steps.acceptance: Two contenders: one winner, loser zero effects; no deadlock; inconsistent records retain evidence.

features.title: Durable start, reprint and recovery without data loss

steps.work: Audit startup env/origin/session publication against existing journal primitives; close remaining nontransactional writes.
steps.acceptance: Fault injection at every write/fsync/rename/commit boundary preserves exact old bytes, modes, absence and trailing newlines or retains a recoverable journal.

steps.work: Qualify live reprint using T only while Serve holds O, with release/run/socket/route revalidation.
steps.acceptance: Concurrent reprints serialize; definite arm rejection rolls back selected origin; ambiguous/persistence failure retains evidence and prints no link.

steps.work: Qualify local-control sockets and bounded messages on native Mac/Linux.
steps.acceptance: Replacement file/symlink/socket survives all constructor/close paths; malformed/wrong-run/oversized/hanging requests refuse. Maintain DR-2's honest guarantee.

steps.work: Explicit stopped-owner recovery with verify-before-mutate, no invitation-consumption guesses.
steps.acceptance: Live owner refusal; edited target/symlink/root mismatch refusal; each journal phase reconciled only when proven. No automatic owner takeover or blind marker deletion.
